The accent picker in Appearance now shows the app icon drawn in each accent, matching the Home Screen icon the iOS app switches to, instead of plain colour dots.

The Gateway page pairs other devices from one Code row: it offers a New code button until a code is minted, then shows the code, how long it stays valid and a copy control.

Bundles gateway 0.16.33 (protocol 93), unchanged from 0.10.10. Build 27.
